name: LValueData.auxPair_lifts_trivialLift
summary: Hecke transfer for the equivariant map Λ = class sum of kernel values, applied to the datum Υ; on the U(1) side the representation is trivial.

steps.claim: Fix a finite place w with w̄ ≠ w and w off the places of X and their conjugates.
steps.lean:
lemma LValueData.auxPair_lifts_trivialLift : X.auxPair.Lifts X.trivialLift 1 := fun _ hw h ↦ by
  have := hecke_transfer_of_equivariant (k :=
    X.auxPair.rankDiff) (by simp [X.one_lt_card.le]) (X.a_hasWeight.charUnramifiedAt rfl rfl) (by
    apply X.b_hasWeight.charUnramifiedAt <;> grind [unramified]) hw (f :=
    X.auxPair.auxDatum.1) (projOn_name_vacElem _ (by aesop)) (stdClassSum X.chosenLevel
    fun g ↦ by use ⟨(X.kernelValue 1 · g), ?_⟩ <;> simp [kernelValue, funext_iff]) 1 (rightRegular
    ..) fun g _ ↦ by ext1; simpa [trivialLift, kernelValue,
    rep_apply_apply] using! congr($(X.trivialLift_eq_stdClassSum_translate g) _).symm
  rw [show (_ : _ →ₗ[ℂ] _) _ = ↑X.trivialLift by ext1; simp [trivialLift]; rfl] at this
  simpa [IsSphericalWith, (isSphericalWith_trivialHecke _ _).2, heckePolyEval, smul_smul,
    sum_range_succ]

steps.claim: The Hecke transfer for an equivariant map (`hecke_transfer_of_equivariant`), applied to the linear map Λ: f ↦ stdClassSum(chosenLevel(X), g ↦ kernelValue(X, 1, f, g)) (the class sum over U(1) of the jets of the kernel), the datum auxDatum(auxPair(X)), the trivial representation of U(1) and the right regular representation on V: Λ is equivariant because the translate of trivialLift(X) by g is the class sum of the translated kernel forms (`LValueData.trivialLift_eq_stdClassSum_translate`), and the characters a, b are unramified at w (`AutChar.HasWeight.charUnramifiedAt`, `LValueData.unramified`) with the datum unramified at w (`Space.projOn_name_vacElem`). It gives: Λ(Υ) is spherical at w for both actions, and its Hecke polynomial at T is trivialHecke(q_w, |n| − 1, α(w)T) times the U(1)-side Hecke polynomial at q_w^{|n|−1}α(w)T/β(w).
steps.lean:
have := hecke_transfer_of_equivariant (k :=
    X.auxPair.rankDiff) (by simp [X.one_lt_card.le]) (X.a_hasWeight.charUnramifiedAt rfl rfl) (by
    apply X.b_hasWeight.charUnramifiedAt <;> grind [unramified]) hw (f :=
    X.auxPair.auxDatum.1) (projOn_name_vacElem _ (by aesop)) (stdClassSum X.chosenLevel
    fun g ↦ by use ⟨(X.kernelValue 1 · g), ?_⟩ <;> simp [kernelValue, funext_iff]) 1 (rightRegular
    ..) fun g _ ↦ by ext1; simpa [trivialLift, kernelValue,
    rep_apply_apply] using! congr($(X.trivialLift_eq_stdClassSum_translate g) _).symm

steps.claim: Identify Λ(Υ) with trivialLift(X) in the statement of step 1.1.
steps.lean: rw [show (_ : _ →ₗ[ℂ] _) _ = ↑X.trivialLift by ext1; simp [trivialLift]; rfl] at this

steps.claim: Λ(Υ) = trivialLift(X), by unfolding trivialLift(X) as the class sum of kernelForm(X); the identification is rewritten into the result of step 1.1.
steps.lean: show (_ : _ →ₗ[ℂ] _) _ = ↑X.trivialLift by ext1; simp [trivialLift]; rfl] at this

steps.claim: On U(1) the representation is trivial, so the U(1)-side Hecke polynomial is trivialHecke(q_w, 1, ·) (`isSphericalWith_trivialHecke`), which is heckePolyEval of the constant system 1; this is the polynomial required by Lifts(auxPair(X), trivialLift(X), 1).
